text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan — passionate, hard-working, and detail-oriented.

I’d be glad to help with your Shopify listings by organizing SKU and pricing data, building accurate product entries, and sourcing missing photos/descriptions from supplier websites when needed. I’m comfortable with data cleaning, spreadsheet-based workflows, and keeping product information consistent and ready for upload. I can also help with basic image cleanup so product photos are square and presentable.

In a recent Shopify project for Juniper & Ash Home, I built customer segments from Shopify order exports using Google Sheets, Looker Studio, and Shopify. The top segment represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and the email revenue increased by 19%.

I have 5 years of experience with data analysis and dashboard work, and I communicate clearly and reliably. I’d be happy to support your store as your supplier list grows.
